Consonantal i

SearchHow we decideRulings

Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

difference noun

how things differ

also what’s the difference?, the difference between, make a difference, distinction

classical

Cic. Off. 1.11: inter hominem et bēluam hoc maximē interest
Ter. Ad. 76: hoc pater ac dominus interest

interest

verb: impersonal, from intersum; inter … et … for the things compared

there is a difference

Latin usually says “difference” with the verb: quid interest inter … et …?, what’s the difference between … and …?; multum interest, it makes a big difference; nihil interest, there’s no difference (see it makes no difference).

Examples

  • Dī inmortālēs, hominī homō quid praestat? stultō intellegēns quid inter est?

    Good gods, how one man can outdo another! What a difference there is between a fool and a man of sense!Ter. Eun. 232–233

  • Hoc pater ac dominus interest: hoc quī nequit, fateātur nescīre imperāre līberīs.

    That is the difference between a father and a master; whoever can’t do it should admit he doesn’t know how to bring up children.Ter. Ad. 76–77

  • sed inter hominem et bēluam hoc maximē interest, quod haec tantum, quantum sēnsū movētur, ad id sōlum, quod adest quodque praesēns est, sē accommodat

    but the chief difference between man and beast is this: the beast, as far as its senses move it, adapts itself only to what is here and nowCic. Off. 1.11

Other words

  • discrīmen, discrīminis n. — difference, distinction

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Gell. 2.26.3: colōrum discrīmina; Cic. Balb. 49: sit hoc discrīmen inter grātiōsōs cīvēs atque fortēs (Lewis & Short)

    Sine discrīmine, without distinction.

  • differentia, differentiae f. — difference, diversity

    noun, first declension · also used · classical · Cic. Off. 1.94: honestī et decōrī (Lewis & Short); Traupman 303

    A word of philosophy and of teaching (Cicero, Quintilian).

  • dissimilitūdō, dissimilitūdinis f. — unlikeness, difference

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Cic. Lael. 74 (Lewis & Short)

See also different, it makes no difference, interest.
